description: Backend fixes and WhatsApp automation: fix document-upload authorization bug in workflows.ts, add GET /properties/:id/documents route, add four new WhatsApp event templates and types, wire enqueueWhatsApp calls into image-upload, document-upload, lead-creation, and inquiry-creation handlers. No Prisma migration needed — PropertyDocument model already exists.
steps: 1. Fix the authorization condition in POST /properties/:id/documents in /var/www/html/be-property/src/routes/workflows.ts. The bug: condition uses `||` when it should use `&&`. Current: `if (!ownerRoles.includes(request.authUser.role) || property.ownerId !== request.authUser.userId)` — this wrongly blocks everyone. Fix: change `||` to `&&` so admins can still upload without ownership, and owners can upload regardless of being in ownerRoles: `if (!ownerRoles.includes(request.authUser.role) && property.ownerId !== request.authUser.userId)`. Also add PDF mime-type validation: after the `part.type !== 'file'` skip, add a check that `part.mimetype` is one of `['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']` and return 400 with `{ error: 'Only PDF, JPEG, PNG, or WebP files are supported', code: 'INVALID_FILE_TYPE' }` otherwise.

2. Add GET /properties/:id/documents route to /var/www/html/be-property/src/routes/workflows.ts. Handler: authenticate, check ownerRoles includes role AND property.ownerId === userId (OR admin). Return all documents for the property: `prisma.propertyDocument.findMany({ where: { propertyId: property.id }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } })`. Returns array with id, type, url, filename, mimeType, status, createdAt.

3. Add four new WhatsAppEventName union members to /var/www/html/be-property/src/whatsapp/types.ts: 'broker_images_uploaded' | 'broker_document_uploaded' | 'new_property_inquiry_broker' | 'new_lead_broker_notice'.

4. Add four new template entries to WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES in /var/www/html/be-property/src/whatsapp/templates.ts:
  - broker_images_uploaded: category UTILITY, variables ['owner_name','broker_name','photo_count','property_title','village'], englishBody: 'Hi {{1}}, {{2}} has uploaded {{3}} new photos for your property "{{4}}" in {{5}}. Log in to review the images.', hindiBody: 'नमस्कार {{1}}, {{2}} ने आपकी संपत्ति "{{4}}" ({{5}}) के लिए {{3}} नई फ़ोटो अपलोड की हैं। फ़ोटो देखने के लिए लॉगिन करें।'
  - broker_document_uploaded: category UTILITY, variables ['document_type','property_title','village','broker_name'], englishBody: 'A legal document ({{1}}) has been uploaded for "{{2}}" in {{3}} by {{4}}. Please log in to review and verify.', hindiBody: '{{4}} ने "{{2}}" ({{3}}) के लिए एक कानूनी दस्तावेज़ ({{1}}) अपलोड किया है। कृपया लॉगिन करके समीक्षा करें।'
  - new_property_inquiry_broker: category UTILITY, variables ['broker_name','buyer_name','purpose','preferred_area'], englishBody: 'Hi {{1}}, new buyer {{2}} is looking for {{3}} land in {{4}}. Check the admin panel for full details.', hindiBody: 'नमस्कार {{1}}, नया खरीददार {{2}} {{4}} में {{3}} भूमि खोज रहा है। पूरी जानकारी के लिए एडमिन पैनल देखें।'
  - new_lead_broker_notice: category UTILITY, variables ['broker_name','buyer_name','property_title','village','buyer_phone'], englishBody: 'Hi {{1}}, {{2}} is interested in "{{3}}" in {{4}}. Phone: {{5}}. Log in to follow up.', hindiBody: 'नमस्कार {{1}}, {{2}} को "{{3}}" ({{4}}) में रुचि है। फ़ोन: {{5}}। फ़ॉलो-अप के लिए लॉगिन करें।'

5. Wire WhatsApp into POST /properties/:id/images in /var/www/html/be-property/src/routes/properties.ts. At the top, add import: `import { enqueueWhatsApp } from '../whatsapp/service.js';`. In the POST images handler, after `prisma.property.update(...)`, add: fetch the property with owner (`prisma.property.findUnique({ where: { id: property.id }, include: { owner: { select: { id: true, name: true, phone: true, whatsappNumber: true } } } })`). If the uploader's userId !== owner.id (i.e. broker uploaded for owner), and owner has a phone, enqueue `broker_images_uploaded` to `owner.whatsappNumber ?? owner.phone` with variables `{ owner_name: owner.name ?? 'Property Owner', broker_name: request.authUser.name ?? 'Broker', photo_count: String(urls.length), property_title: property.title, village: property.village }` and dedupeKey `broker-images:${property.id}:${Date.now()}`. Wrap in `.catch(() => undefined)` so upload never fails due to WhatsApp errors. The `request.authUser` type may not have `name` — add `name?: string` to the authUser type or just read it from a DB lookup.

6. Wire WhatsApp into POST /properties/:id/documents in /var/www/html/be-property/src/routes/workflows.ts. After the document loop completes and `created` array is populated, fetch property owner. If uploader !== owner, enqueue `broker_document_uploaded` to owner's phone (wrap in .catch). Also enqueue the same notification to `process.env.ADMIN_PHONE` (if set) so admin knows a document was uploaded. Use dedupeKey `broker-doc:${document.id}` per document.

7. Wire WhatsApp into POST /leads in /var/www/html/be-property/src/routes/leads.ts. Add import for `enqueueWhatsApp`. After `prisma.lead.create(...)`, fetch the property with owner: `prisma.property.findUnique({ where: { id: parsed.data.propertyId }, include: { owner: { select: { role: true, phone: true, whatsappNumber: true, name: true } } } })`. If owner exists and owner.role is BROKER or AGENT, enqueue `new_lead_broker_notice` to `owner.whatsappNumber ?? owner.phone` with variables `{ broker_name: owner.name ?? 'Broker', buyer_name: parsed.data.buyerName, property_title: property.title, village: property.village, buyer_phone: parsed.data.buyerPhone }`. dedupeKey: `lead-broker:${lead.id}`. Wrap in .catch(() => undefined).

8. Update .env.example at /var/www/html/be-property/.env.example to document the WhatsApp keys (WHATSAPP_TOKEN, PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WABA_ID, VERIFY_TOKEN, APP_SECRET, WHATSAPP_API_BASE) with empty values so operators know to set them.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in /var/www/html/be-property completes with zero TypeScript errors
POST /properties/:id/documents returns 403 for users who neither own the property nor are admin
POST /properties/:id/documents returns 400 for non-PDF/non-image file uploads
GET /properties/:id/documents returns the list of documents for an authenticated owner
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES has all four new entries with correct variable counts
WhatsAppEventName type includes all four new event names
enqueueWhatsApp is imported and called (wrapped in .catch) in properties.ts, workflows.ts, and leads.ts
verification: cd /var/www/html/be-property && npm run build — must exit 0 with no errors
findings: Prisma client was stale — schema had WhatsApp models (WhatsAppMessage, WhatsAppContact, WhatsAppOptIn) but the generated client did not include them. Ran `npx prisma generate` to fix before build. The `authUser` type only has {userId, phone, role} — broker name for WhatsApp notifications is fetched from a DB lookup (prisma.user.findUnique). The leads.ts WhatsApp notify reuses the `property` variable already fetched earlier in the same handler scope. FEAT-002/FEAT-003 (frontend + Flutter) can use GET /properties/:id/documents and the fixed POST endpoints directly.
